task.description: Diagnose ISS-0132 (GH #427): inventory allocation sites vs errdefer guards in src/engine/transition.zig and src/definition/store.zig for cloneJsonValueSafe/cloneObjectMapSafe, parseTimerConfig, parseGraphJson. Confirm or correct the issue's '51 alloc sites / 12 errdefer' figure by actually counting. Write docs/issue-reports/ISS-0132-diagnosis.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: alloc-site and errdefer counts measured, not quoted
remaining gap vs prior GH #428 work identified

result.summary: Counted 110 alloc sites / 15 errdefer in transition.zig production region (issue's '51/12' is outdated and understated) and 35 alloc / 8 errdefer / ZERO test blocks in store.zig. Found GH #428 already landed alloc-failure tests TC-ISS-0132-01/02/03 plus fixes for parseTimerConfig and cloneJsonValueSafe/cloneObjectMapSafe; the remaining gap is parseGraphJson, which has no coverage and is reachable from no addTest root. Identified 3 defects there: PGJ-1 fragile errdefer/deinit pairing, PGJ-2 partial-struct leak in nodes loop, PGJ-3 same in edges loop.
